# YouTube, Kick, Meld Studio, OBS filters and Parse

C# methods for a **Run C# code** step. See [C# methods](index.md) for how to use them.

## YouTubeGetBroadcaster

Gets the YouTube account you signed in with as the broadcaster: its name, handle, id and picture.

```csharp
YouTubeUserInfo? YouTubeGetBroadcaster()
```

**Gives back:** The account (UserName, UserLogin, UserId, ProfileImageUrl, LastActive), or null when no broadcaster is signed in.

**Example**

```csharp
var me = CPH.YouTubeGetBroadcaster();
if (me != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Broadcaster: {me.UserName}");
```

## YouTubeGetBot

Gets the YouTube bot account you signed in with: its name, handle, id and picture.

```csharp
YouTubeUserInfo? YouTubeGetBot()
```

**Gives back:** The account, or null when no bot account is signed in.

**Example**

```csharp
var bot = CPH.YouTubeGetBot();
CPH.LogInfo(bot != null ? $"Bot: {bot.UserName}" : "No YouTube bot");
```

## SendYouTubeMessageToLatestMonitored

Sends a message in the chat of your newest YouTube stream that Cuebot watches. Uses the bot account, or the broadcaster as fallback. Empty text sends nothing.

```csharp
void SendYouTubeMessageToLatestMonitored(string message, bool useBot = true, bool fallback = true)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SendYouTubeMessageToLatestMonitored("Thanks for watching!");
```

## YouTubeSetTitle

Changes the title of your YouTube stream. Without a broadcast id it changes your newest watched stream.

```csharp
bool YouTubeSetTitle(string title, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the title was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.YouTubeSetTitle("Speedrun practice!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Title changed: {ok}");
```

## YouTubeSetDescription

Changes the description of your YouTube stream. Without a broadcast id it changes your newest watched stream.

```csharp
bool YouTubeSetDescription(string description, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.YouTubeSetDescription("Playing with viewers all night.");
```

## YouTubeSetCategory

Changes the category of your YouTube stream, by name like "Gaming" or "Music", or by YouTube's category number.

```csharp
bool YouTubeSetCategory(string categoryName, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the name is not a YouTube category.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.YouTubeSetCategory("Gaming");
CPH.LogInfo($"Category changed: {ok}");
```

## YouTubeSetPrivacy

Changes who can see your YouTube stream: "public", "unlisted" or "private".

```csharp
bool YouTubeSetPrivacy(string privacy, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or nothing was given.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.YouTubeSetPrivacy("unlisted");
```

## YouTubeSetMetaData

Changes title, description, privacy and category of your YouTube stream in one go. Leave a value empty (null) to keep it.

```csharp
bool YouTubeSetMetaData(string? title, string? description, string? privacy, string? categoryName, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when every change worked, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.YouTubeSetMetaData("Late night chill", null, "public", "Gaming");
CPH.LogInfo($"Updated: {ok}");
```

## YouTubeAddTags

Adds tags to your YouTube stream. Tags it already has are not added twice.

```csharp
bool YouTubeAddTags(List<string> tags, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.YouTubeAddTags(new List<string> { "speedrun", "retro" });
```

## YouTubeRemoveTags

Removes the listed tags from your YouTube stream.

```csharp
bool YouTubeRemoveTags(List<string> tags, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.YouTubeRemoveTags(new List<string> { "retro" });
```

## YouTubeClearTags

Removes all tags from your YouTube stream.

```csharp
bool YouTubeClearTags(string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.YouTubeClearTags();
```

## YouTubeBanUserById

Bans someone from your YouTube chat by their channel id.

```csharp

```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the id was empty.

**Example**

```csharp

CPH.LogInfo($"Banned: {ok}");
```

## YouTubeBanUserByName

Bans someone from your YouTube chat by name: a recent chatter's name or an @handle.

```csharp
bool YouTubeBanUserByName(string userName, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

**Example**


Times someone out in your YouTube chat for some seconds, by their channel id.

```csharp
bool YouTubeTimeoutUserById(string userId, int duration, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the id was empty.

## YouTubeTimeoutUserByName

Times someone out in your YouTube chat for some seconds, by name or @handle.

```csharp
bool YouTubeTimeoutUserByName(string userName, int duration, string? broadcastId = null)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

**Example**


## KickBanUser

Bans someone from your Kick chat by name. You can add a reason. The bot setting is ignored.

```csharp
bool KickBanUser(string userName, string? reason = null, bool bot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.KickBanUser("spambot123", "Spam links");
CPH.LogInfo($"Banned: {ok}");
```

## KickTimeoutUser

Times someone out in your Kick chat for some seconds. Kick counts in minutes, so it is rounded up. The bot setting is ignored.

```csharp
bool KickTimeoutUser(string username, int duration, string? reason = null, bool bot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.KickTimeoutUser("loudviewer", 300, "Calm down");
```

## KickUnbanUser

Lifts a ban or timeout on Kick, by name. The bot setting is ignored.

```csharp
bool KickUnbanUser(string userName, bool bot = false)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.KickUnbanUser("loudviewer");
```

## KickDeleteChatMessage

Deletes one message in your Kick chat, by the message's id.

```csharp
bool KickDeleteChatMessage(string messageId)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the id was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
if (CPH.TryGetArg("msgId", out string msgId)) CPH.KickDeleteChatMessage(msgId);
```

## KickReplyToMessage

Replies to a message in your Kick chat. Uses the bot account, or the broadcaster as fallback.

```csharp
bool KickReplyToMessage(string message, string replyId, bool useBot = true, bool fallback = true)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the text was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
if (CPH.TryGetArg("msgId", out string msgId)) CPH.KickReplyToMessage("Good question!", msgId);
```

## KickSetTitle

Changes the title of your Kick stream.

```csharp
bool KickSetTitle(string title)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the title was empty.

**Example**

## KickSetCategory

Changes the category of your Kick stream, by name (or id).

```csharp
KickCategory? KickSetCategory(string categoryName)
```

**Gives back:** The category (only its name, and its id when you gave a number), or null when Kick refused.

**Example**

```csharp
var category = CPH.KickSetCategory("Just Chatting");
CPH.LogInfo(category != null ? $"Now in {category.Name}" : "Kick refused");
```

## SetKickUsersVarById

Sets a user variable to the same value for every Kick user id in the list. Persisted true keeps it after Cuebot restarts.

```csharp
void SetKickUsersVarById(List<string> userIds, string varName, object? value, bool persisted = true)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.SetKickUsersVarById(new List<string> { "1234", "5678" }, "team", "red");
```

## MeldStudioConnect

Starts connecting to Meld Studio. Cuebot keeps trying in the background. Cuebot has one Meld Studio connection, so use -1 or 0.

```csharp
bool MeldStudioConnect(int connectionIdx = -1)
```

**Gives back:** true when connecting started, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MeldStudioConnect();
```

## MeldStudioDisconnect

Disconnects from Meld Studio. Use -1 or 0 for the connection; other numbers only write a warning.

```csharp
void MeldStudioDisconnect(int connectionIdx = -1)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MeldStudioDisconnect();
```

## MeldStudioIsConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Meld Studio right now.

```csharp
bool MeldStudioIsConnected(int connectionIdx = -1)
```

**Gives back:** true when connected, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool connected = CPH.MeldStudioIsConnected();
CPH.LogInfo($"Meld connected: {connected}");
```

## MeldStudioGetConnectionByName

Gives the number of a Meld Studio connection. Cuebot has only one, so any name gives 0.

```csharp
int MeldStudioGetConnectionByName(string name)
```

**Gives back:** 0 when Cuebot's Meld Studio part is loaded, otherwise -1.

**Example**

```csharp
int idx = CPH.MeldStudioGetConnectionByName("Main");
CPH.LogInfo($"Meld connection: {idx}");
```

## MeldStudioShowScene

Switches Meld Studio to a scene, by its Meld id. A scene name works too.

```csharp
bool MeldStudioShowScene(string sceneId, int connectionIdx = -1)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or nothing was given.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MeldStudioShowScene("Gameplay");
```

## MeldStudioShowSceneByName

Switches Meld Studio to a scene by its name, like "Gameplay".

```csharp
bool MeldStudioShowSceneByName(string sceneName, int connectionIdx = -1)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
bool ok = CPH.MeldStudioShowSceneByName("Gameplay");
CPH.LogInfo($"Scene switched: {ok}");
```

## MeldStudioShowLayerByName

Shows a layer in Meld Studio, by the scene name and the layer name.

```csharp
bool MeldStudioShowLayerByName(string sceneName, string layerName, int connectionIdx = -1)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the layer name was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MeldStudioShowLayerByName("Gameplay", "Webcam");
```

## MeldStudioHideLayerByName

Hides a layer in Meld Studio, by the scene name and the layer name.

```csharp
bool MeldStudioHideLayerByName(string sceneName, string layerName, int connectionIdx = -1)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, false when it failed or the layer name was empty.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.MeldStudioHideLayerByName("Gameplay", "Webcam");
```

## ObsCreateRecordChapter

Adds a chapter mark to your OBS recording, like "Boss fight". Needs OBS 30.2 or newer, recording as Hybrid MP4.

```csharp
bool ObsCreateRecordChapter(string chapterName, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true when it worked, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsCreateRecordChapter("Boss fight");
```

## ObsIsFilterEnabled

Checks whether a filter is turned on in OBS. Give a scene and filter name, or a scene, source and filter name for a source's filter.

```csharp
bool ObsIsFilterEnabled(string scene, string filterName, int connection = 0)
bool ObsIsFilterEnabled(string scene, string source, string filterName, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** true when the filter is on, otherwise false.

**Example**

```csharp
bool on = CPH.ObsIsFilterEnabled("Gameplay", "Webcam", "Blur");
CPH.LogInfo($"Blur on: {on}");
```

## ObsSetFilterState

Sets an OBS filter: 0 turns it on, 1 turns it off, 2 flips it. Give a scene's filter, or a scene, source and filter for a source's filter.

```csharp
void ObsSetFilterState(string scene, string filterName, int state, int connection = 0)
void ObsSetFilterState(string scene, string source, string filterName, int state, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetFilterState("Gameplay", "Webcam", "Blur", 0);
```

## ObsToggleFilter

Flips an OBS filter on or off. Give a scene's filter, or a scene, source and filter for a source's filter.

```csharp
void ObsToggleFilter(string scene, string filterName, int connection = 0)
void ObsToggleFilter(string scene, string source, string filterName, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsToggleFilter("Gameplay", "Webcam", "Blur");
```

## ObsSetRandomFilterState

Picks one random filter of a scene (or of a source) and sets it: 0 on, 1 off, 2 flip. Nothing happens when there are no filters.

```csharp
void ObsSetRandomFilterState(string scene, int state, int connection = 0)
void ObsSetRandomFilterState(string scene, string source, int state, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsSetRandomFilterState("Gameplay", "Webcam", 0);
```

## ObsHideSourcesFilters

Turns off every filter of an OBS source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

```csharp
void ObsHideSourcesFilters(string scene, string source, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsHideSourcesFilters("Gameplay", "Webcam");
```

## ObsHideScenesFilters

Turns off every filter of an OBS scene.

```csharp
void ObsHideScenesFilters(string scene, int connection = 0)
```

**Gives back:** Nothing.

**Example**

```csharp
CPH.ObsHideScenesFilters("Gameplay");
```

## Parse

Fills in the variables in a text: %arguments%, ~global variables~ and inline functions. Give your own values to use instead of this run's arguments.

```csharp
string Parse(string input, Dictionary<string, object?>? args = null)
```

**Gives back:** The text with every variable filled in.

**Example**

```csharp
string text = CPH.Parse("Thanks for the raid, %user%!");
CPH.SendMessage(text);
```
